source: Department of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries of Preah Vihear Province (មន្ទីរកសិកម្ម រុក្ខាប្រមាញ់ និងនេសាទ ខេត្តព្រះវិហារ), presentation "ដំណើរការផលិតកម្មគ្រាប់ពូជស្រូវសុទ្ធ" (Process of Pure Rice Seed Production), presented by Ms. Yem Sokey (យឹម សុគី), Deputy Head of the Office of Agricultural Techniques and Agricultural Productivity, dated 20 November 2017. Contact: ysophy168@gmail.com, 012 558 312.
text:
Rice harvested and bundled into sheaves for pure seed production should be threshed by hand (beating the sheaves against a rack or board), and threshing should be done as soon as possible after harvest to prevent quality loss.

Because the goal is pure seed rather than ordinary grain, threshing should keep each seed lot/variety physically separate from every other lot during the process, in order to maintain purity and prevent varieties from mixing together. If rice from different varieties or different harvest times will be threshed on the same threshing floor, the floor must be swept clean and cleared of any leftover grain from the previous lot before starting to thresh the next lot, so that no residual seed from one variety contaminates the next.
